title_zh: 安排桃子甜点的拌料与奶油

scenario.label_zh: 安排桃子甜点的拌料与奶油
scenario.goal_zh: 根据桃子已变软的状态确定拌料动作并分工打奶油和分装水果

context_zh: 两位朋友在家准备桃子甜点，桃子已经烤好，相关食材均为普通烹饪材料。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: The peaches are tender already. Should they go back in the oven?

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: No, they're ready. Just toss them gently in the juice at the bottom of the dish.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Gently is the key word. I don't want them turning into a bowl of mush.

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: I'll whip the cream while you divide the fruit between the bowls.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Deal. Do you want a big serving or a small one?

sentences.speaker: Max
sentences.text: Small, please. I want room for the cake too.
